theorem PV_DIAG6.honest_joint_native : ∀ {S A W R P C : Type} (honest : W → Prop) (pub : W → P) (coins : W → R → C)
  (actualCount : W → R → ℕ) (l1Count : P → C → ℕ) (actual : W → R → PV_DIAG3.Execution S A)
  (events : P → C → List PV_DIAG3.Event) (terminal : P → C → PV_DIAG3.Exit A),
  (∀ (w : W) (r : R), honest w → actualCount w r = l1Count (pub w) (coins w r)) →
    (∀ (w : W) (r : R), honest w → (actual w r).events = events (pub w) (coins w r)) →
      (∀ (w : W) (r : R), honest w → (actual w r).exit = terminal (pub w) (coins w r)) →
        ∀ (w : W) (r : R),
          honest w →
            PV_DIAG6.diagnosticPieces (actualCount w r) (actual w r) =
              (l1Count (pub w) (coins w r), events (pub w) (coins w r), terminal (pub w) (coins w r)) :=
fun {S A W R P C} honest pub coins actualCount l1Count actual events terminal existingL1Count nativeDiagnosticLaw
    nativeTerminalLaw w r hw =>
  id
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            (_a, (actual w r).events, (actual w r).exit) =
              (l1Count (pub w) (coins w r), events (pub w) (coins w r), terminal (pub w) (coins w r)))
          (existingL1Count w r hw)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              (l1Count (pub w) (coins w r), _a, (actual w r).exit) =
                (l1Count (pub w) (coins w r), events (pub w) (coins w r), terminal (pub w) (coins w r)))
            (nativeDiagnosticLaw w r hw)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                (l1Count (pub w) (coins w r), events (pub w) (coins w r), _a) =
                  (l1Count (pub w) (coins w r), events (pub w) (coins w r), terminal (pub w) (coins w r)))
              (nativeTerminalLaw w r hw)))
          (Eq.refl (l1Count (pub w) (coins w r), events (pub w) (coins w r), terminal (pub w) (coins w r))))))
theorem PV_DIAG6.whole_prefix_family_law : ∀ {A R : Type} [inst : Fintype R]
  (a b : R → ℕ → ℕ × List PV_DIAG3.Event × PV_DIAG3.Exit A), (∀ (r : R) (n : ℕ), a r n = b r n) → R0Z.EqualLaws a b :=
fun {A R} [Fintype R] a b h =>
  have hab := funext fun r => funext fun n => h r n;
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => R0Z.EqualLaws _a b) hab)) fun value => Eq.refl (R0Z.law b value)
theorem PV_DIAG6.recover_every_emitted_event : ∀ {S A : Type} (recover : PV_DIAG3.Execution S A → List PV_DIAG3.Event),
  (∀ (x : PV_DIAG3.Execution S A), recover x = x.events) →
    ∀ (f : PV_DIAG6.PrefixFamily S A) (i j : ℕ), i ≤ j → ∀ e ∈ (f.sample i).events, e ∈ recover (f.sample j) :=
fun {S A} recover lossless f i j h e he =>
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => e ∈ _a) (lossless (f.sample j))))
    (PV_DIAG6.event_prefix_member (f.sample i).events (f.sample j).events (f.coherent i j h) e he)

theorem PV_DIAG6.write_step_joint : ∀ {S E : Type} (rel : S → S → Prop) (a b : PV_DIAG3.WriteOps S E)

  rel s t →
    a.zeroError = b.zeroError →
      (∀ (bs : PV_DIAG3.Bytes) (u v : S), rel u v → PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel (a.write bs u) (b.write bs v)) →
        (∀ (e : E) (u v : S), rel u v → PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel (a.interruptedGuard e u) (b.interruptedGuard e v)) →
          (∀ (e : E) (u v : S), rel u v → PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel (a.dropInterrupted e u) (b.dropInterrupted e v)) →
            (∀ (bs : PV_DIAG3.Bytes) (n : ℕ) (u v : S),
                rel u v → PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel (a.slicePanic bs n u) (b.slicePanic bs n v)) →
              (∀ (bs : PV_DIAG3.Bytes) (u v : S), rel u v → PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel (ka bs u) (kb bs v)) →
                PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel (PV_DIAG3.writeAllStep a buf ka s) (PV_DIAG3.writeAllStep b buf kb t) :=
fun {S E} rel a b ka kb buf s t h hz hw hg hd hp hk =>
  id
    (Decidable.casesOn (instDecidableEqBool (List.isEmpty buf) true)
      (fun h_1 =>
        Eq.mpr (id (congr (congrArg (PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel) (congrFun (if_neg h_1) s)) (congrFun (if_neg h_1) t)))
          (PV_DIAG3.coupled_bind rel (a.write buf s) (b.write buf t)
            (fun r =>
              match r with
              | Except.ok 0 => PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error a.zeroError)
              | Except.ok n.succ =>
                if n + 1 ≤ List.length buf then ka (List.drop (n + 1) buf) else a.slicePanic buf (n + 1)

                  if interrupted = true then PV_DIAG3.sequence (a.dropInterrupted e) fun x => ka buf
                  else PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error e))
            (fun r =>
              match r with
              | Except.ok 0 => PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error b.zeroError)
              | Except.ok n.succ =>

                  else PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error e))

              out = t →

                                    u)

                                    | Except.ok 0 => PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error b.zeroError)
                                    | Except.ok n.succ =>
